facts.value: Sun Devil Day is a one-day on-campus event designed with you in mind. Tour one of our campuses, meet with college representatives and current students, and explore student life.
ASU offers tools and support services aimed at helping you succeed and earning your degree.
Tutoring helps students keep focused on their studies, work through challenging course content, prepare for quizzes and exams, and think through project goals and plans.
ASU offers comprehensive career counseling and resume review services to support students and alumni in their professional development through one-on-one advising and career peer advising.
The general timeline is four years, but it’s OK to take longer if needed. Many students graduate in less than four years.
